question: Should OpenClaw accept committing native compaction results that are produced during this PR's bounded safety-timeout cancellation window?
rationale: The patch is mechanically coherent and tested, but it changes when aborted compaction work may still append session state after a timeout, which needs owner intent before merge.

options.title: Accept bounded timeout progress
options.body: Land the PR after normal maintainer review, treating the bounded acceptance window as the intended recovery policy for this bug.

options.title: Require stronger native proof
options.body: Ask for one more exact-head proof artifact that exercises the real AgentSession compaction path through the timeout-commit window.

options.title: Reject this policy
options.body: Pause or close the PR and keep the linked issue open for a different design such as per-stage budgets or persisted chunk checkpoints.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded timeout progress
recommendation.body: Land the PR after normal maintainer review, treating the bounded acceptance window as the intended recovery policy for this bug.
